armageddon_progression_id_memo.conversion: Exact variant: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on every ResourceLocation.parse (62 sites, all constant strings), ItemTags.create (47), TagKey.create (2) and ResourceLocation.toString (45, registry ids for the config lists) call in the private execute of the 15 progression procedures (two mixins, one per execute descriptor): bounded ConcurrentHashMaps hand out the result the original returned for the same input (successful parses only). Callers use the results by value (map lookups, tag tests, List.contains), so the one internal difference is object identity (kept ids and strings instead of new equal ones; tag keys are interned either way). Runtime flag armageddonProgressionIdMemo (+ .shadow). Helper bons.furious.patch.armageddon_coo49.ProgressionIds. The 1.21.1 build has the same 15 procedures and the same site counts as the Forge 1.20.1 build (ForgeRegistries.ITEMS became BuiltInRegistries.ITEM)
